description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and arbitrary strings to deterministic color values, primarily for use in dashboards with dark backgrounds. It includes functions for generating pastel hues from strings and mapping known statuses to theme colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel RGB HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while keeping saturation and lightness suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a themed color, with known statuses mapped to theme tokens and unknowns to a soft amber color. Uses colorFromString for arbitrary strings.
